description:
[Updates] What one Rust build changed: items, recipes, loot, research, recycling. What a Rust patch changed in the game data the wiki reads from the server files. Per dataset: `status` (applied/unchanged/held), and the `added`, `changed` (`field`, `old`, `new`) and
`removed` rows, each with a `key`, `label` and a rust.wiki `url` where one exists. Up to 500 rows per list
(`truncated` says when more were recorded). Only items live on rust.wiki are listed - rows about anything not
released yet are left out. build=latest for the newest patch. Without dataset= you get per-dataset counts and a few examples; pass dataset=items|recipes|research|recycle|loot|npc_health|commands for that dataset's rows.

build.description: A build id from `/game-data-changes`, or `latest` for the newest.

name: get_game_data_changes
title: What one Rust build changed: items, recipes, loot, research, recycling
